topic: Three settings to check before AI touches your inbox

sources.title: Automatic sending

# Automatic sending

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

Several popular email assistants can be configured to send replies automatically without anyone reviewing them first.

sources.title: Draft-only mode
sources.markdown:
# Draft-only mode

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

In draft-only mode, every reply the assistant writes waits in the drafts folder until a person sends it.

# Retention settings

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

The retention setting controls how long the provider keeps copies of processed messages on its servers.

# Access scopes

Synthetic evaluation fixture: a fictional source with invented figures, written for the BlogFactory engine eval suite.

Access scopes decide which mailboxes and folders the assistant may read, so it can be kept away from finance or HR mail.
